source: actual supplied Opus recordings with a local Range server; no production writes
environment: Owned headless Microsoft Edge, empty isolated profile, extensions disabled, cache disabled, 960x600; real Web Audio analyser

checks.name: baseline reproduces two competing pending songs before either can play
entry stays silent and downloads no recording before intent
cold throttled play starts with an incomplete recording
real Opus produces nonzero master output before full buffering
switching an unready song aborts its actual HTTP request immediately
expected cancellation leaves the selected song loading without an error
mute before first sample cancels every pending download and playback
explicit mute survives reentering the journey without new downloads
reselecting a cancelled recording restores its URL and reuses its player
already audible music continues while the next recording buffers
crossfade ends on the selected song and pauses the outgoing one
morning and evening keep the shared recording without reloading
the original real recording still loops at its end
network failure has an explicit error and resets loading
retry after a real failed response restores playback
a previously audible but now unready song also releases its pending request
dispose aborts an unready request and closes its AudioContext
production keeps development globals private
real production UI plays its relative-path Opus asset
production period control selects its night recording
no JavaScript exceptions in cold, failure, cancellation or production cases
